text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco and Belgium to set up joint commissions to improve fight against drug trafficking and illegal immigration.
- Togo withdraws its recognition to the Polisario Front.
- U.S. Development Agency (USAID) grants Morocco $500,000 to support its privatisation programme.
- Seaman arrested on suspicion of sexual abuse and rape of about 20 youngsters aged between eight and 14 since 1993.
- Morocco's Human Rights Association (AMDH) holds news conference on Thursday to assess local council elections.
- International Monetary Fund says in report that Morocco is among few Arab countries that made headway towards healthier economy owing to financial reforms and privatisation.
